description.zh-CN: 测试长文本、图片与文件在输入区和消息中的完整交互。
description.en: Test long text, images, and files in the composer and messages.

description.zh-CN: 选择一种输入示例，可继续粘贴长文本、选择图片或添加文件。
description.en: Choose an example, then paste text, select images, or attach files.

label.zh-CN: 请分析我粘贴的长文本并给出摘要
label.en: Analyze my pasted text and summarize it

assistant.zh-CN: 我收到了长文本。这里用于检查长文本标记、预览和消息气泡的布局。
assistant.en: I received the long text. This checks its marker, preview, and message layout.

assistant.zh-CN: 我看到了图片。这里用于检查图片选择、缩略图、预览和发送状态。
assistant.en: I can see the image. This checks selection, thumbnails, preview, and delivery states.

label.zh-CN: 请读取我添加的文件并概括内容
label.en: Read the attached file and summarize it

assistant.zh-CN: 我收到了文件。这里用于检查附件卡片、长文件名和发送状态。
assistant.en: I received the file. This checks attachment cards, long filenames, and delivery states.
